item.title: CELTIC RED CARD APPEAL
item.description: CELTIC will appeal Auston Trusty’s red card which occurred in a flashpoint moment during the 2-2 draw with Hearts at Tynecastle on Sunday. The Hoops were leading 2-1 by the 74th minute when the USA international defender was dismissed following a coming together with striker Landry Kbore about 15 yards outside the penalty box. item.title: DICKINSON IN CHARGE
item.description: DAVID DICKINSON will be in charge of Celtic’s Premiership encounter against Falkirk at Parkhead on Sunday. The match official will be assisted by David Roome and Chris Rae on the flanks while Andrew Dallas will be in control in the VAR studios. It will be Dickinson’s second game as referee in a Hoops game this [...]

item.title: The story of Vasilios Barkas
item.description: Vasilios Barkas returns to Celtic Park on Thursday, four and a half years after his last appearance at the ground. That 1-1 draw with Midtjylland was our first home game in front of fans in 16 months, with 9,000 allowed to attend. It was also Vasilios’ only appearance for Celtic in front of a home [...]

item.title: ALEX’S ANGLE: BEATON + VAR = RED CARD FOR CELTIC
item.description: AUSTON TRUSTY became the first Celtic player to be red-carded in 86 domestic games when he was dismissed at Tynecastle on Sunday. Intriguingly, the previous Hoops performer to be banished was Yang Hyun-jun at the same venue in March 2024. Both Trusty and Yang were yellow-carded in occurrences just under two years apart. item.title: CELTIC’S £1.5m MISFIT ON MOVE
item.description: CELTIC’S £1.5million misfit striker Shin Yamada has agreed a short-term loan deal with German second-tie club Preussen Munster. The Japanese frontman, who was recruited from Kawasaki Frontale on a four-year contract in the summer, has failed to score a solitary goal in his 11 appearances for the Hoops. item.title: WIM’S SEASON IN PARADISE: PART THREE

item.title: ‘VERY DISAPPOINTED,’ CELTIC WANT SFA TALKS AFTER RED CARD APPEAL DISMISSED
item.description: CELTIC will be looking for further discussions with the SFA after the club’s appeal against Auston Trusty’s red card in the 2-2 draw with Hearts on Sunday was dismissed. The Hoops hierarchy say they are “very disappointed” with the decision of an independent panel and the centre-back will now miss the Premiership encounter with Falkirk [...]

item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL insists Celtic will have to rise to the occasion when they face FC Utrecht in the Europa League clash at Parkhead tomorrow night.
